name: Fresh Pasta Salad
body:
Station and Complexity garde manger 6

Flavor Profiles temperature, sweet, umami, salty, spicy, texture
Additional Ingredients bitter, salty, sour, texture, or umami

EFFECT

Duration 1 hour/level; Serving Size 6

DESCRIPTION

Fresh pasta salad is a cold, cooked pasta commonly mixed with cheese, cured meats, olives, tomato, herbs, oil and vinegar.

When consumed, it grants a +6 bonus on saving throws against curses, hexes, and negative emotion-based effects (such as crushing despair, rage, or fear effects) for the duration.

Additional ingredients increase the duration and serving size by +1 each.
